messages:
ae_claire: Hi team — Finly (Ciara) on enterprise POC. They're seeing first-token latency ~850ms for short prompts (~20 tokens). Cold starts happening even after steady traffic. Also saw intermittent 429s when they bumped concurrency to 12 req/s. Can we swarm?
se_jordan: Can you drop a recent trace_id and a sample prompt? Also which model variant and deployment: Dedicated or Hosted?
ae_claire: trace: 20260321T15:04:22Z/trace-8b2f; prompt: 'Summarize the attached policy in 3 bullets.' Model: open-redwood/gptj-6b-quant, deployment: Dedicated (dedicated-poc-finly-west).
eng_ops_lee: looking at logs for trace-8b2f — I see repeated WARN prefetch: kvcache_miss key=ctx:finly:session:abc and then 'start_inference delayed pending_batch'. That suggests KV cache not being warmed and continuous batching holding long. Snippet from the node logs: 
```
WARN prefetch: kvcache_miss key=ctx:finly:session:abc
INFO batching: queued=6 window_ms=50
DEBUG runtime: select_kernel=quant_fast
```
se_jordan: Two things to try quickly: 1) run a KV prefill script to populate the common context keys, 2) reduce batch window to ~10–12ms or set the route to "latency" profile so short requests don't wait for large batches.
se_jordan: Example prefill (run from ops bastion):
```bash
for i in {1..8}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.company/v1/internal/prefill \n    -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxxxx' \n    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n    -d '{"deployment":"dedicated-poc-finly-west","key":"ctx:finly:session","payload":"<warm-prefix>"}'; \n  sleep 0.2
done
```
eng_ops_lee: I queued a prefill job (job id pref-993) and kicked off a warmup run. Also instrumented a temporary metric: prefetch_miss_rate.
deploy-bot: scaled dedicated-pool/dedicated-poc-finly-west by +2 GPUs (new size 6) — scaling event id s-4477 :rocket:
se_jordan: I see the 429s were hitting a per-shard concurrency ceiling — we can bump the per-deployment throttle to 20rps for the POC window. @ae_claire do you want us to approve a 1-hour bump?
ae_claire: please bump, they have a demo in 30m.
eng_ops_lee: Done — raised shard throttle to 20rps for dedicated-poc-finly-west until 1719104834. Also set batch_window_ms=12 for the Finly route.
sec_olive: Quick heads-up — Finly's security questionnaire asked for KMS integration details and audit log retention. I'll send a sanitized KMS diagram and SOC cert. @ae_claire can you forward to their legal team?
ae_claire: Will send. Also customer asked about pricing for reserved capacity vs burst — what guidance should I give them now?
finance_bry: For a POC sized like this (6-GPU pool) recommend a provisional reserved price of ~$30k/mo with optional monthly burst credits (~$5k/mo). If they prefer pay-as-you-go we can provide an estimate based on observed token volume; rough reference: heavy generation workloads land ~ $0.04–$0.08 per output token depending on quantization and batching. I'll follow up with a formal quote.
customer_ciara: Ran the prefill script and warmed a few sessions. TTFT dropped to ~150–220ms on our short prompts. Still saw 1–2 429s during a quick ramp but much better overall. Thanks for the fast response :clap: 
se_jordan: Great to hear. I'll keep the prefetch_miss alert at alert if rate > 2/min and monitor traces for any lingering "pending_batch" delays. If misses persist we'll increase prefill frequency or pin the most common prefixes in the warm cache.
ae_claire: Closing the loop — demo scheduled, we'll do a post-demo retro to lock in recommended route config (batch_window, prefill cadence, throttle). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
